[@sakaladev/usai](/docs/sdk/) / test



`@sakaladev/usai/test` — run the same application model tests will
meet in production. The harness spawns the `usai` runtime for the
project, talks HTTP to the application, and invokes tasks, cron ticks
and commands deterministically through the control surface: no wall
clock, no external server. Start with [testApp](/docs/sdk/test/functions/testapp/).

## Testing

| Name | Description |
| ------ | ------ |
| [TestAppOptions](/docs/sdk/test/interfaces/testappoptions/) | Options for [testApp](/docs/sdk/test/functions/testapp/). |
| [TestResponse](/docs/sdk/test/interfaces/testresponse/) | One HTTP response from the application under test: `body` is the parsed JSON when the response was JSON, otherwise the text. |
| [RequestOptions](/docs/sdk/test/interfaces/requestoptions/) | Options for `app.http.*`. |
| [WorkOutcome](/docs/sdk/test/interfaces/workoutcome/) | The result of a task, cron tick or command run through the control surface: the handler's value or its error, the world's termination, the lifecycle `violations` it committed (detached work, an open transaction) and its log lines. A test asserts on all of it. |
| [TestApp](/docs/sdk/test/interfaces/testapp/) | A running application under test; see [testApp](/docs/sdk/test/functions/testapp/). |
| [LogLine](/docs/sdk/test/interfaces/logline/) | One line of the runtime's JSON log, as `TestApp.logs` returns it. |
| [SseEvent](/docs/sdk/test/interfaces/sseevent/) | One server-sent event as `TestStream.next` returns it. |
| [TestStream](/docs/sdk/test/interfaces/teststream/) | An open event stream. |
| [SocketOptions](/docs/sdk/test/interfaces/socketoptions/) | Options for `TestApp.socket`. |
| [TestSocket](/docs/sdk/test/interfaces/testsocket/) | An open WebSocket. |
| [TestSocketRefused](/docs/sdk/test/classes/testsocketrefused/) | Thrown by `TestApp.socket` when the server answered the upgrade with an HTTP status instead of `101` (a refused credential is a `401`). |
| [LogFilter](/docs/sdk/test/interfaces/logfilter/) | What `TestApp.logs` / `waitForLog` select on; every given field must match. |
| [UsaiTestError](/docs/sdk/test/classes/usaitesterror/) | Thrown when the harness itself fails: the binary is missing, the runtime did not start, a control request was refused. |
| [testApp](/docs/sdk/test/functions/testapp/) | Start the application under the real runtime for a test: the same artifact, the same boundaries, the same worlds production will run. The harness spawns the `usai` binary (`USAI_BIN`, `binary`, or `usai` on PATH) on random ports with a control token, waits for it to announce itself, and talks HTTP to the application and to the control surface. Tasks, cron ticks and commands run deterministically through the control surface — no wall clock, no external server — and answer with a [WorkOutcome](/docs/sdk/test/interfaces/workoutcome/) that includes the world's lifecycle violations, so a test can fail on detached work the way production would. |

## Other

| Name | Description |
| ------ | ------ |
| [WorldLogLine](/docs/sdk/test/interfaces/worldlogline/) | One line a world wrote, as the outcome carries it. |
| [Termination](/docs/sdk/test/type-aliases/termination/) | How a world ended. The four the runtime names, plus the open form so a future one is a value and not a type error. |
